_note: Campfires for home levels 4-6 (hearth = 4, bonfire = 5, brazier = 6). size_m = [width (X), height, depth] in metres, Godot axis order (Blender X, Z, Y). collision = footprint seen from above: circle radius_m. Front faces Blender -Y (Godot +Z). Origin on the ground at the footprint centre. Each has a separate mesh node `flame` (origin at the base of the flame, for flame.gdshader).

props.name: campfire_hearth
props.notes: home level 4: stone hearth (two courses of cut stones, 0.45 m) with a crib of split logs and a hanging pot on an iron crane at the back right; flame is a separate object (origin at its base, 0.12 m up); marker_ring in front (-Y)

props.name: campfire_bonfire
props.notes: home level 5: great bonfire (log tepee 1.1 m) in a ring of mossy boulders, carved posts left and right; flame is a separate object (origin at its base, 0.1 m up); marker_ring in front (-Y)

props.name: campfire_brazier
props.notes: home level 6: crystal brazier, a wide stone bowl (rim 0.72 m) cupped by carved leaves on a short pedestal and stone dais, ringed by six clusters of glowing amber/gold crystals; flame is a separate object (origin at its base, 0.69 m up, in the bowl); marker_ring in front (-Y)
